summary: Investigated how session forking and tree navigation should be supported by reading the agent-server source (session-catalog-service, session-repository, journal-store, pi-agent-types), the protocol session request schemas, and the upstream @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent type definitions for navigateTree and SessionManager. A parallel audit subagent reported findings on the tree UI, runtime branching, and recommended semantics such as branching only on prompt submit, keeping the old branch immutable, and using one server-side navigation operation. No files were modified.
